intended_behavior: Add cache_strategy: Optional[str] = None to the base Model class (likely in constructor or config definition) and ensure get_config() returns this parameter. This allows all model implementations to uniformly accept and expose cache_strategy configuration.

Modify the constructor to check if model.get_config().cache_strategy == "auto" after self.model is set. If yes, automatically add ConversationCachingHook instance to self.hooks via self.hooks.add_hook(). This enables automatic caching hook registration driven by model config.

Extend BedrockModel's config handling to include cache_strategy parameter from the base config. Preserve existing native pass-through handling of injected cachePoint blocks when cache_strategy="auto".

Add cache_strategy to AnthropicConfig handling and ensure it propagates via get_config(). Confirm existing cachePoint to cache_control conversion against cache_strategy="auto" to maintain correct prompt caching behavior.
Support cache_strategy in LiteLLMConfig and get_config. Fix the logic in system message formatting to handle injected cachePoint blocks correctly at message-level for cache_strategy="auto".

Implement ConversationCachingHook class as a HookProvider. It must register for BeforeModelCallEvent, and upon receiving the event, inject a cachePoint block into the last assistant message's content before the model call is made. This mechanism enables the automatic injection of cachePoint to cover system prompt, tools, and conversation history for caching.
